shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底两件套主图
一秒传达清爽百搭的核心利益，承接点击
代入逛街聚会等真实外穿场景，强化百搭联想
用放大的针织纹理证明面料品质与穿着舒适
并排展示多色可选，降低选择疑虑促进凑单
用规整的尺码版面消除选码疑虑，数值后期合成

用留空的资质占位与品质氛围降低购买风险
以促销氛围与行动按钮位收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots alternating with soft sakura-pink #F7C8D8 info panels and light neutral street backdrops #E9E7E3
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single rose accent #E56A96
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful youthful kids-fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft sakura pink #F7C8D8, charcoal ink #26262A and one rose accent #E56A96; bright soft high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable hero product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment set; flat lay reserved for spec and variant screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte board #F5F4F2 and smooth pavement grey #E9E7E3
